einzeiler: Breaking down massive midterm election wins, progressive momentum, and what comes next
kurzfassung: The hosts and guests celebrate a sweeping series of Democratic victories and progressive upsets in the recent midterm elections. They discuss the challenges of holding power, legislative strategy against the Trump administration, and foreign policy regarding Israel. The episode also features lighthearted segments, including political negotiation games and audience rants.
stichpunkte: Comprehensive breakdown of surprising Democratic and progressive wins in state and federal midterm races
Discussion with New York City Councilmember Chi Osei and author Heather McGhee on political organizing and history
Comparison of current political momentum to historical periods like Reconstruction
Congressional strategy debate with Representative Brad Lander on how to handle government funding and investigations
Analysis of U.S. policy and rhetoric surrounding the Israeli-Palestinian conflict
Audience participation segment celebrating local political victories and personal achievements
beschreibung:
Republicans try to keep their heads above water as that big Blue Wave crashes over America, baby. Meanwhile, Trump ignores the beam in his own eye, and the White House stocks up on frozen baby mice to feed new Chief of Staff Stephen Miller. On the show, New York City Councilman Chi Osse and Heather McGhee talk firsts, (hopefully) lasts, and I told you sos from the 2026 midterms, while Brad Lander rolls up his sleeves and digs into Democrats’ new priorities in Congress. The Rant Wheel spins and Lovett sprints, off the stage and into the crowd, to lib out with our incredible Crooked Con audience.
